intent: Repair the seq109 handoff field-semantic drift and extend the existing continuity/governance integration so the capability hard gate validates .longcycle/handoff/current.json through the canonical SessionHandoffCheckpoint model before full pytest. Keep workstream lifecycle state in status rather than inventing structural roles, and keep non-campaign research indexes in deep_context_paths rather than reusing memory-campaign coverage_path.
rationale_summary: Seq109 exposed a control-plane validation gap: the canonical typed handoff model rejects an invented workstream role and a campaign-only coverage_path when memory_campaign is null, but capability_registry.validate_handoff currently checks only that the compact capability index appears in resume_read_set. Reuse CAP-0009 as the semantic owner of handoff shape and CAP-0010 as the owner of the preflight hard gate; do not create another schema or validator.
